تستقدروا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِرُوا (tastaqdirū) /tas.taq.di.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# تُسْتَقْدَرُوا (tustaqdarū) /tus.taq.da.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
